command: kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get configmaps -o wide; kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pod -o yaml | grep -E "^\s+(name|configMapRef|configMapKeyRef|configMap):|kind:" | head -100

kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get configmaps; kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pod -o json | jq -r '.items[] | [.kind,.metadata.name, ([.. | objects | (.configMap?.name, .configMapRef?.name, .configMapKeyRef?.name) | select(.!=null)] | unique | join(","))] | @tsv'
kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pod -o json | grep -n -i -E '"(name|kind)": ' | head -150
kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pod -o json | grep -i -E 'configmap|"name"|"kind"'
kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pod -o json | grep -i -E 'configmap|kind|name'
kubectl -n wiki-64e9 get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pod -o json | grep -i -e configmap -e kind -e name
kubectl -n wiki-64e9 delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023
